{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

output = Path('/app/aggregates.json')
data = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert list(data) == ['top_5_users_by_amount', 'top_5_tags_by_count']
users = data['top_5_users_by_amount']
tags = data['top_5_tags_by_count']
assert len(users) == 5
assert len(tags) == 5
raw = output.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for name, value in users.items():
    assert isinstance(value['total_amount'], float)
    assert isinstance(value['total_items'], int) and not isinstance(value['total_items'], bool)
    assert re.search(r'"total_amount": -?\d+\.\d{2}', raw)
user_rows = [(name, value['total_amount']) for name, value in users.items()]
assert user_rows == sorted(user_rows, key=lambda row: (-row[1], row[0]))
for name, value in tags.items():
    assert isinstance(value['count'], int) and not isinstance(value['count'], bool)
tag_rows = [(name, value['count']) for name, value in tags.items()]
assert tag_rows == sorted(tag_rows, key=lambda row: (-row[1], row[0]))
print('validated: 5 users, 5 tags, ordered values, two-decimal amounts, integer counts')
PY"}
